attribution: Contains modified EUMETSAT MTG-I Lightning Imager AFA data, CC BY 4.0. Local markers are derived activity-area centroids.
representation: Derived satellite lightning-activity areas from EUMETView's five-minute colourised AFA coverage. They are approximate cloud-top activity-area centres, not individual strikes, flash points, CG/IC classifications, or intensity values.
